_meta.purpose: Tournament lineage for points-to-defend.json: which api-tennis edition a target event's 'last year' is. Everything not named here joins by atpId (tier-map source_url) or by name.
_meta.rulings: Founder brief round 2 item 2.3 (2026-10-25): Brussels lineage = Brussels only, never Antwerp; Lyon 2026 (atpId 496, October, hard) is a NEW tournament — never mapped to Lyon (May, clay), Marseille or Stockholm.

brussels.name: Brussels
brussels.note: The European Open moved Antwerp -> Brussels in 2025; api-tennis keeps Antwerp's tournament_key 3669 and names the 2025 edition 'Brussels'. Only editions NAMED Brussels count, so no Antwerp edition is ever a prior.

lyon.name: Lyon
lyon.note: Lyon 2026 (October, indoor hard) is a new event: firstEdition, no rows. Not Lyon May (clay), not Marseille, not Stockholm.

nanterre.name: Paris
nanterre.note: draws.json names the Paris Masters by its 2026 venue city (Paris La Defense Arena, Nanterre).
